entities.name: Poq
entities.description: A burly Malamet catfolk shaman and mythweaver of Ixalan's underworld.

entities.name: Okinec Ahau
entities.description: Ruler of the Malamet who sentences the Legion of Dusk members to death.

entities.name: Malamet
entities.description: Catfolk realm in the underworld of Ixalan.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Newcomers judged hostile by Poq's vision.

events.summary: At Okinec Ahau's command Poq conjures a green mist that forms a snarling face reacting violently to the Legion of Dusk.
events.quote: Poq stepped forward and used his powers to create a swirling green mist that formed into a snarling face.

events.summary: Poq shakes his head to tell the Sovereign the newcomers are not to be trusted.
events.quote: shaking his head to indicate that the newcomers were not to be trusted

events.summary: Okinec Ahau sentences the Legion members to death.
events.quote: The Sovereign decided to sentence the Legion members to death

relations.quote: Poq is introduced as the mythweaver for Sovereign Okinec Ahau
Mythweaver Poq is a Malamet shaman from Ixalan
